evaluation.protocol: Scene-disjoint development/holdout pilot. Only development labels select thresholds; no product threshold changes.
evaluation.visualGuard: aspect relative difference <= 0.025; dHash <= 12; mean RGB distance <= 48; both luma deviation >= 12

visualGuardOnlyAblation.protocol: Post-hoc diagnostic using the already fixed visual guard, without cosine or threshold retuning; not a new confirmatory holdout.

analysisNote: Thresholds and model are unchanged after the first held-out result. The visual-guard-only ablation was added post hoc to diagnose model contribution using these retained pair measurements; it is not a fresh confirmatory holdout.
limits: 51 photographs from 17 staged indoor scenes under controlled lighting; 8 development and 9 holdout scenes.
No verified burst times; the conservative no-time non-ML baseline rejects all cross-lighting pairs. This is not a representative comparison of all ordinary app use.
Post-hoc guard-only ablation is diagnostic, without threshold retuning.
Software-allowed WebGL is not hardware-GPU evidence; Chromium emitted a software-fallback deprecation warning. No unsafe browser flags were added.
No consumer-burst, human-preference, physical Android/iPhone or <=1% population false-group guarantee.
Portable CPU is much slower per inference than the earlier MediaPipe experiment on different CI runs; timings are not a controlled cross-runtime benchmark.
